title: Config safety thresholds + golden-prompt acceptance harness for cost recommendations
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description:
Background: We need an automated acceptance harness that validates any automated batching/caching configurations (recommendations applied by the Cost Tuner) do not introduce measurable quality regressions. Current autotune flows can push config changes that reduce token cost but occasionally degrade output structure or factuality for a subset of customers. This ticket scopes a lightweight, reproducible eval harness that uses a curated set of golden prompts, multiple comparison metrics (semantic similarity, structured-field match, and answer presence), and configurable thresholds to accept or reject a config apply.

Goals:
- Define a small but representative golden prompt set for core customer workloads (chat, summarization, instruction-following).
- Define a composite divergence score and per-metric acceptance thresholds for safe auto-apply.
- Implement an acceptance harness that runs in the canary/apply pipeline and outputs deterministic pass/fail + regression diagnostics.
- Wire automatic rollback (or hold for manual review) when harness fails, with clear telemetry surfaced in Console.

Scope:
- Author golden prompt corpus (initial 120 prompts across domains) and tagging by workload and sensitivity.
- Implement runner that executes baseline and candidate configs in parallel on a shadow canary slice and computes metrics.
- Compute three primary signals: embedding-distance (semantic drift), structured-match (JSON/field-level coverage), and behavioral-sanity (e.g., hallucination heuristics and answer completeness).
- Define composite score and per-metric thresholds, plus time-window gating (e.g., require 95% pass over N requests or block).
- Produce a per-change dashboard and an actionable summary for SD/PM review.

Out of scope: full-scale A/B experiments across all customers, deep human evaluation for each change (we will sample on failures).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Golden prompt corpus added to repo and linked in runbook.
2) Harness executes in CI/canary pipeline and returns pass/fail in under 20 minutes for up to 200 prompts.
3) Composite divergence score defined and documented, with default thresholds that block >2% semantic drift or >1% structured-match regressions vs baseline.
4) Failed runs trigger automatic hold and create an incident-like ticket with diff artifacts and top 10 failing prompts.
5) Console shows per-config result, metric breakdown, and links to failing examples.
rollout_plan:
1) Week 1: land golden prompt corpus + runner skeleton behind feature flag (internal-only).
2) Week 2: run offline lab experiments comparing 10 previously problematic auto-applies to validate thresholds.
3) Week 3: enable harness on shadow canary for Cost Tuner proposals (no auto-blocking, record-only).
4) Week 4: iterate thresholds, add dashboard panels, and enable auto-blocking for low-risk customers.
5) Week 6: full auto-blocking with manual override and rollback workflow for enterprise accounts.
instrumentation: Log: harness.run.{id}.status, metrics: embedding_distance_mean, structured_match_recall, behavioral_sanity_rate, pass_rate. Traces: link config->harness_run->canary_jobs. Alert: harness.failures > 1 per hour triggers P0 incident in PagerDuty for production applies. Telemetry will be viewable under Console -> Cost Optimization -> Safety Evaluations.
